profile_draft.name: Abiali Doctor
profile_draft.intro: I build web applications with JavaScript and TypeScript, working across React and Next.js interfaces, Node.js APIs, databases, and cloud deployments.
story: My earlier work spans client websites, reservation systems, employee marketing tools, a wedding marketplace, and a wellness platform.
I work across interface development, API integration, backend services, and deployment, translating product requirements and designs into working applications.

projects.name: Wedfield
projects.summary: A wedding marketplace connecting couples with vendors, venues, and products, with customer and business apps, an admin console, and a shared backend.
projects.problem: Wedding planning required connected workflows for discovering suppliers, managing purchases, communicating with vendors, and organising events.
projects.built: Built Next.js customer, vendor, and admin applications and Node.js/Express APIs backed by MongoDB. Implemented vendor and venue listings, real-time messaging, payments, delivery integration, reviews, guest lists, invitations, and planning tools. Built an invitation editor with WhatsApp integration and packaged customer and vendor applications for mobile with Capacitor. Managed AWS EC2 deployments and S3 uploads.

projects.name: ZanaduHealth
projects.summary: A wellness platform connecting employees with health coaches through video sessions.
projects.problem: Employees and coaches needed a shared platform for accessing wellness services and joining remote coaching sessions.
projects.built: Developed frontend interfaces with Next.js and TypeScript, integrated APIs using RTK Query, and implemented Agora video sessions. Built Node.js/Express API routes, controllers, middleware, and models, with JWT authentication, file uploads, logging, and AWS S3 image storage. Worked with a four-person development team.

projects.name: Spotsaver
projects.summary: A reservation platform with visitor booking, brand management, administration, and QR-based check-in workflows.
projects.problem: Visitors, brand managers, administrators, and security staff needed coordinated tools to manage reservations and check-ins.
projects.built: Joined an existing application and developed React interfaces from Figma designs. Integrated APIs with RTK Query for booking and management workflows, and worked with clients and QA to resolve issues and deliver features. The platform included personal and group reservations, cancellations, store management, and QR-based reservation completion.

projects.name: Niusafe
projects.summary: An employee-facing marketing platform for discovering company content and sharing it through social channels.
projects.problem: Employees needed a central place to find company posts and take part in social marketing.
projects.built: Extended an existing React application, translated Figma designs into responsive interfaces, and connected frontend workflows to APIs with RTK Query. Worked with the client and testing team on feature delivery and issue resolution.
